**CS 3: Chinese Zodiac( Documentation)**

**Requirement:**   
**![][image1]**  
**Actual Code:**  
Chinese\_Zodiac \= \["Rat (鼠 / Shǔ)", "Ox (牛 / Niú)", "Tiger (虎 / Hǔ)", "Rabbit (兔 / Tù)", "Dragon (龙 / Lóng)",  
                  "Snake (蛇 / Shé)", "Horse (马 / Mǎ)", "Goat (羊 / Yáng)", "Monkey (猴 / Hóu)", "Rooster (鸡 / Jī)",  
                    "Dog (狗 / Gǒu)", "Pig (猪 / Zhū)"\]

year \= int(input("Enter your birth year: "))  
zodiac \= (year \- 4) % 12  
if year \< 1900:  
    print("Invalid Year, it should not be earlier than 1900")  
else:  
    print("Your Chinese Zodiac sign is:", Chinese\_Zodiac\[zodiac\])  
**Output:**  
**![][image2]**
